description: "The Rolliad, in Two Parts" by Tickell, Ellis, Laurence, and Richardson is a work of British political satire published serially in 1784–85.
longDescription: This collaborative work takes the ingenious form of literary criticism examining a fictional epic poem about John Rolle, MP for Devon, being guided through Parliament by Merlin.

Probationary Odes for the Laureatship & Political Eclogues. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
